note: F0-S2 synthetic pull, hand-authored. PRE-SHAPED: these records are what the stitcher (F4-S3) will one day produce from raw RentCast responses -- nothing here is derived, every field is asserted by the fixture author. Deliberately covers the pathological cases the graph must survive: a comp with no sqft (premium=None all the way down), two still-active/censored comps (removal_class null -- censored is never a kind of leased), two cohort years (premium is measured against a comp's OWN cohort), each rung of the removal ladder (pending/provisional/confirmed), a withdrawal-suspect comp, and price cuts. fetched_at is deliberately in the past: 'as_of is the pull date, not the wall clock' is untestable if a fixture is stamped today. ROW 10B: every comp also states first_listed -- the stitched start date real shaping always sets (pipeline/shape.py::_build_comp) and the date removed_on, and therefore DerivedComp.days_since_removal, is measured from. Without it a removed comp went over the wire carrying a removal rung beside a null count, i.e. the row 'removed nulld -- classifying', while responses.py declares that field null IFF removal_class is null. first_listed is not free: cohort_year is its year, removed_on is it plus effective_dom, and the removal rung is the ladder applied to as_of minus removed_on -- so the pre-shaped format lets an author state one fact four times, which is how they drifted apart. backend/tests/unit/test_r10b_preshaped_pulls_are_shapeable.py re-ties them, over this directory's listing rather than a fixed list of filenames, so a new pre-shaped pull is covered the day it is added. Two fields here were reconciled to it, cohort_year deliberately untouched everywhere so no psf/premium/anchor/band/weight figure moves: 655 W Imaginary Pl #5 is censored, and a censored comp's DOM is a floor measured to the pull date, so a 2025 start cannot have been on market only 88d by 2026-05-04 (effective_dom 88 -> 124); 311 W Hypothetical Ter G claimed 'provisional' when no 2025 start with dom 41 is anything but 'confirmed' on 2026-05-04 (-> confirmed). 1318 N Invented Ave still carries the provisional rung, so this pull still covers the whole ladder, and provisional/confirmed are both 'leased' (pipeline/buckets.py) so no bucket statistic moved either.
